# Make the file fail on purpose

Use the participation worksheet for this activity. Work with your group, record your reasoning on the worksheet, and submit it as directed in class.

[Download the participation worksheet](week-01-make-the-file-fail-participation.docx){.btn .btn-primary}
:::

The activity asks you to distinguish useful repeated identifiers from descriptive information stored repeatedly, identify inconsistencies and assumptions, propose a first model, and defend one rule the data system should enforce.

Before beginning, review the Week 1 lecture, [Is a database just a glorified spreadsheet?](../lectures/week-01-database-or-spreadsheet.qmd).
